label: Equivalence before quality
subgoals: Run equivalence checking on every design in the suite
Treat counterexamples as rejections and timeouts as holds
Apply the QoR rule only to proved results

label: Computing and reporting deltas
subgoals: Compute each design's percentage change against the baseline
Summarize with the mean of percentages beside the per-design list
Measure delay with the reference timer

label: What makes a golden suite trustworthy
section: What makes a golden suite trustworthy
subgoals: Fix the baseline to the promoted recipe with identical inputs
Track run time and check that a targeted change moves only its targets
